definitions.explanation: the emotional state or feeling of being lonely or desolate

examples.japanese: {別|わか}れの{寂|さび}しさに{耐|た}える。
examples.english: To endure the sadness of parting.

examples.japanese: {一人|ひとり}{暮|ぐ}らしの{寂|さび}しさを{紛|まぎ}らわす。
examples.english: To distract oneself from the loneliness of living alone.

notes:
FORMATION:
{寂|さび}しい (lonely - adjective) + さ (nominalizing suffix)

USAGE:
- {寂|さび}しさを{感|かん}じる (to feel loneliness)
- {寂|さび}しさに{耐|た}える (to endure loneliness)
- {寂|さび}しさを{紛|まぎ}らわす (to distract from loneliness)
- {寂|さび}しさを{埋|う}める (to fill the loneliness)

VARIANT:
{淋|さび}しさ is an alternative kanji spelling with the same meaning.

RELATED EMOTIONS:
- {孤独|こどく} (solitude, isolation)
- {切|せつ}なさ (bittersweetness, sadness)
- {虚|むな}しさ (emptiness)

RELATED:
- {寂|さび}しい (lonely - adjective)
- {孤独感|こどくかん} (feeling of loneliness)
- {郷愁|きょうしゅう} (nostalgia, homesickness)
